$comment: The konteks-remote commands a person runs on a connected computer, one plain line each, for the systems each applies to (runtime-view R20). The connector carries them in its executable and sends them on the heartbeat as connectorCommands with its bundle version (packages/release/src/connector-commands.ts); a release also ships them as commands.json (scripts/release-assets.mjs commands). packages/launcher/src/__tests__/connector-commands.test.ts checks every entry against the launcher's real command table, and that every command a person runs is listed.

commands.description: Shows whether this computer is connected to Konteks and ready for work.
Lists the agents on this computer and whether each one is ready.
Checks the connector and every agent on this computer, and says what to fix.
Installs the newest connector release and restarts the connector. Running work finishes first.
Says whether a newer connector release is available, without installing it.
Shows which agents are signed in on this computer.
Signs an agent in on this computer: claude-code, codex, dsh, opencode or antigravity.
Signs an agent out on this computer.
Adds an agent to this computer's connector: claude-code, codex, dsh, opencode or antigravity.
Removes Google Antigravity from this computer, with its download and its sign-ins here.
Binds this installation to the local agent Skill folders it may synchronize.
Synchronizes the latest Skills this runtime is allowed to use and reports each agent profile.
Shows Skill versions, sharing audience, initiative restrictions and agent profile status.
Shares a complete Skill with a system; repeat --system and --initiative as needed, or use --organization instead. --yes confirms automatic publication of future edits.
Stops sharing a runtime Skill with its current audience. The local source and published version history remain.
Lists this computer's session previews and why any of them stopped. Turn previews on or off in Konteks.
Starts the connector's background service.
Stops the connector's background service. This computer and its work are kept.
Creates this computer's key for Konteks-managed repositories and registers it.
Lists the keys registered for this computer.
Collects a support bundle to share with Konteks support.
Prints the connector release this computer runs.
Removes Konteks from this computer. Your repositories and your agents' own sign-ins stay.
